capabilities: Cascade seen property checks and clears from series to linked seasons and episodes
Auto-check a season or series when all of its children are seen
Maintain derived progress properties (season_count, seasons_seen, completion)
Recalculate all TV progress from the command palette after bulk edits
disambiguation: Not a TV tracking or cataloging tool; it only synchronizes the seen property and derived counts on notes you already maintain.
extras: Expects a fixed folder layout (Film & TV/TV/) and specific note schemas; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to keep a watched/unwatched property consistent across a series note and its linked season and episode notes, so states drift apart after edits.
summary: Cascades a seen checkbox property across linked TV series, season, and episode notes and maintains derived progress properties.
